versions.changelog:
## Stonecutter Woodworks 1.0

First release.

- Cut planks into stairs, slabs, fences, fence gates, doors, trapdoors and pressure plates in the stonecutter.
- Works for oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove and cherry planks: 56 recipes.
- One plank gives two slabs or one of everything else, so the amounts stay close to the crafting table.

## Stonecutter Woodworks 1.1

Now also for Minecraft 26.3.

- The same zip works on Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3: the recipes are included in the format each version reads.
- Same 56 recipes on every version, nothing changes on 1.21 and 1.21.1.

## Stonecutter Woodworks 1.2

Three more woods.

- Bamboo, crimson and warped planks now work in the stonecutter too: stairs, slabs, fences, fence gates, doors, trapdoors and pressure plates.
- 21 new recipes, 77 in total, with the same amounts as before: one plank gives two slabs or one of everything else.
- Works on Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3 as before. Pale oak is not included, because it only exists in 26.3.
